judul: A two-stage fine-tuning strategy for 3D object segmentation from multi-view images
bukti_ai2: a two-stage fine-tuning strategy for 3D object segmentation that preserves the original NeRF architecture and loss function entirely || Experiments on synthetic fruit datasets and real-world soybean imagery demonstrate that InvNeRF-Seg produces cleaner 3D segmented point clouds compared to both SA3D and FruitNeRF, enabling more accurate downstream object counting.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut angka hitung maupun acuan hitung; 'anotasi' diduga dari pemakaian data sintetis dengan jumlah yang diketahui. Data nyata berupa kedelai (polong), bukan buah pohon. Pencacahan adalah tugas hilir, kontribusi utama adalah segmentasi 3D.

judul: Video-based fruit detection and tracking: effects of scanning conditions on fruit load estimation
bukti_ai2: This study presents a computer vision system based on video multi-object-tracking for fruit load estimation in apple orchards || The system integrates fruit detection, tracking, localization within orchard, and fruit load map generation. || bilateral scanning improved fruit load estimation at the stretch level by incorporating information from both sides of the canopy
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut nama pelacak maupun cara penghapusan duplikat; M3+M4 mengikuti konvensi pelacakan plus lokalisasi. Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitung; 'pohon' adalah dugaan dari konteks estimasi muatan buah per pohon. Abstrak tidak menjelaskan cara data dua sisi digabung. Akuisisi juga diulang pada dua tanggal, tetapi sebagai kondisi pembanding.

judul: Instance segmentation and multi-object tracking for fruit quality grading and dynamic yield estimation in Egyptian citrus orchards
bukti_ai2: For dynamic yield estimation, a multi-object tracking pipeline was implemented using BoT-SORT with camera-motion compensation and a virtual line-crossing counting mechanism. || the best quality-resolved dynamic grader (YOLOv11s, WMAPE = 6.97% at 14.2 ms per frame)
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut modul re-ID pada BoT-SORT sehingga dikodekan M3 sesuai konvensi. Abstrak tidak menyatakan acuan hitung; diasumsikan hitungan dari anotasi video. Cara penetapan kelas mutu pada lintasan tidak dinyatakan.

judul: Adapting SAM3 for 3D fruit counting with cross-view contrastive learning and Hough voting
bukti_ai2: we devise a Hough voting procedure in the 3D Gaussian space to integrate multi-view evidence of occluded fruits, followed by clustering to estimate the number of fruits as well as their 3D locations || we adopt cross-view contrastive learning with uncertainty weighting for enhanced 3D feature representation
catatan_ai2: M5 diberikan karena fitur 3D dilatih dengan contrastive learning lintas pandang; dapat juga dibaca sebagai M4 saja. Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitungan; 'anotasi' diasumsikan dari adegan sintetis dan dataset beranotasi. Tidak jelas apakah F1 adalah metrik hitung atau deteksi 3D.

judul: MFFT: an improved method for stable ID tracking and counting of multi-class mango segmentation with multi-feature fusion in complex occlusion scenarios
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] MFFT is a multi-feature fusion tracking method addressing low segmentation accuracy, frequent ID switches, and large tracking and counting errors under complex occlusion. || [parafrasa web] In the tracking stage, IOU, HSV, shape, and diagonal features are fused, together with an improved Kalman filter and ID lifecycle management, resulting in a MOTA of 0.6513.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak verbatim tidak ditemukan; kode didasarkan pada parafrasa hasil pencarian. Fitur HSV dan bentuk dikodekan M2, IoU dan Kalman filter M3. Judul menyebut pencacahan multikelas (mangga di pohon dan mangga jatuh), tetapi parafrasa tidak memuat angka hitung per kelas sehingga per_kelas diisi N; perlu diperiksa pada teks lengkap. Akuisisi video dan referensi anotasi disimpulkan dari penggunaan MOTA, tidak dinyatakan eksplisit.

judul: Robot-assisted Neural Radiance fields for plot-level cotton crop 3D reconstruction and yield estimation
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] A NeRF-based workflow integrates data acquisition, 3D reconstruction and cotton boll mapping at field-plot level; 10 cameras on a custom robotic platform scan the plants. || [parafrasa web] NeRF reconstructs 3D models of plot-level cotton plants from RGB images and exports point clouds; boll counting per plot uses an improved FruitNeRF.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak web tidak menyebut pembanding hitungan maupun angka galat; referensi_hitung 'tidak ada' berarti tidak dinyatakan pada bukti yang terbaca, dan tingkat_metrik 'hitung' disimpulkan dari tugas penghitungan per plot. Akuisisi berupa pemindaian bergerak (robot multi-kamera atau video ponsel), dikodekan V; D juga dapat dibela.

judul: Development of a real-time non-contact yield mapping system using cascading neural networks for wild blueberry harvesters
bukti_ai2: A novel non-contact yield monitoring system was developed for wild blueberry harvesters using 3D Time-of-Flight imaging. || collecting and analyzing a comprehensive dataset of 37,196 point cloud files from 95 harvested totes || Cascading neural networks were used for point cloud segmentation, debris quantification, and mass estimation.
catatan_ai2: Kamera ToF mengukur volume dan massa buah yang sudah dipanen di mesin pemanen (bersama kotoran), bukan buah pada tanaman; tidak ada deteksi buah individual. E2 dipilih sebagai alasan terdekat (pencitraan pascapanen); E1 juga dapat dibenarkan. Abstrak tidak merinci posisi kamera pada mesin pemanen.

judul: 3D reconstruction and segmentation of grape bunches for robotic berry thinning
bukti_ai2: We propose a robot-integrated vision pipeline that reconstructs grape bunch structure from posed multi-view RGB images. || Camera poses are derived from the robot kinematic chain, allowing the reconstructed point cloud and detected berry centers to be expressed directly in the metric robot base frame || RANSAC sphere fitting achieved a counting MAE of 0.50 berries, RMSE of 0.71 berries
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut pembanding hitungan; "pohon" (hitung manual pada tandan) adalah dugaan. Abstrak juga tidak menyatakan apakah tandan masih di tanaman atau di laboratorium; bila hanya laboratorium, E2 dapat berlaku. Sebagian kontribusi adalah manipulasi (penjarangan), tetapi pencacahan buah dievaluasi sehingga bukan E4.

judul: A lightweight multi-view detection and counting method for real-time cherry tomato yield estimation using greenhouse inspection robots
bukti_ai2: this study proposes a lightweight “detection–tracking–counting–compensation” cascaded network framework, optimized for deployment on inspection robots || a multi-view cooperative detection and compensation method was proposed to optimize multi-object tracking performance in dense and occluded scenes
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut nama pelacak, cara kerja kompensasi multipandang (kemungkinan memuat asosiasi geometris atau koreksi statistik), maupun acuan hitung. Mekanisme dikodekan M3 berdasarkan pelacakan multiobjek; akuisisi V diasumsikan dari robot inspeksi yang bergerak. referensi_hitung diisi "tidak ada" karena sumber yang terbaca tidak menyatakannya, bukan karena dipastikan tidak ada.

judul: Maturity and size estimation with yield mapping for hydroponic strawberries using machine vision
bukti_ai2: RGB-D images are processed with YOLOv8-seg and a BoT-SORT-based tracking module to obtain instance-level masks, from which a color-based ripeness index and 3D point clouds are derived. || assign each strawberry to one of nine operational size–maturity categories using predefined threshold rules || Yield maps aggregated in 1 m2 cells and by crop row revealed marked spatial variability in fruit density, maturity state, and size–maturity composition
catatan_ai2: BoT-SORT tanpa keterangan modul re-ID dikodekan M3. GNSS RTK dipakai untuk georeferensi peta; abstrak tidak menyatakan bahwa posisi dipakai untuk asosiasi buah, sehingga M4 tidak diberikan. Akurasi hitungan tidak dievaluasi di abstrak; validasi hanya segmentasi dan ukuran buah. Kepadatan buah per kategori dipetakan sehingga per_kelas Y.

judul: SawitMVC: A multi-view oil palm fruit bunch dataset for detection and counting
bukti_ai2: Photographing each tree from multiple positions captures all visible bunches but introduces a cross-view deduplication problem: the same bunch appears in several images || A separate per-tree JSON ground truth layer records 9823 unique bunches with their cross-view appearance links, supporting direct evaluation of counting algorithms independently of detection performance. || [parafrasa web] Validasi teknis memakai faktor koreksi global k = 1,8905 (14.041 kotak / 7.427 tandan unik pada data latih) dan SVR dengan vektor fitur lintas pandang 13 dimensi; SVR lebih baik pada Tree ±1 dan MAE.
catatan_ai2: Makalah dataset; kontribusi utamanya anotasi tautan lintas pandang, sedangkan metode asosiasi hanya baseline statistik (faktor koreksi k dan SVR), sehingga dikode M1 dan bukan DATA. Baseline tidak mengidentifikasi tandan individual. Hitungan per kelas B1–B4 dilaporkan (Class ±1); kelas berasal dari detektor per citra lalu diregresikan, cara agregasi kelas antarpandang tidak dinyatakan. Halaman dikosongkan karena teks dibaca dari PMC, bukan PDF.

judul: A Short-Term Yield Prediction Method for Greenhouse Strawberries Integrating Visual Phenology and Meteorological Sequences
bukti_ai2: an image repository of 784 original images annotated into five distinct phenological classes (flower, green, white, pink, and red) || by fusing these visual markers with meteorological time series (e.g., temperature, humidity, and light intensity), we construct a multimodal spatiotemporal feature matrix || BiTCN-SA achieves strong performance with a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.958 and a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.154
catatan_ai2: Tanaman yang sama dipantau berulang selama 72 hari sehingga C1 (akuisisi T, tanpa asosiasi buah, M0) dapat diperdebatkan; abstrak tidak menyebut langkah yang menghubungkan buah antarcitra, sehingga dikodekan C4 (hitungan per tahap fenologi dari citra tunggal untuk prediksi hasil).

judul: Geometry-Driven Triangulation and Differentiable Semantic Gaussian Refinement for 3D Grape Bunch Model Reconstruction in the Field
bukti_ai2: reconstructs a semantic 3D model of individual berries from handheld field video || Stage 2 forms multi-view tracks using epipolar constraints, azimuth-based neighborhood restriction, and radius consistency (without appearance descriptors), then triangulates and consolidates 3D berry centers via geometric gating and 3D non-maximum suppression || On 30 real-field bunches with labelled point-cloud ground truth converted to 3D ellipsoids, the refined models achieve F1 scores of 78.7–88.5%
catatan_ai2: Acuan adalah awan titik berlabel (bukan hitungan tangan); abstrak tidak melaporkan galat jumlah buah, hanya F1 pencocokan elipsoid 3D. Penghalusan Gaussian terdiferensiasi tetap bersifat geometris sehingga tidak dikode M5.

judul: A Modular UAV-Based Framework for Apple Detection and Yield Extrapolation from 3D Point Clouds
bukti_ai2: UAV-derived 3D point clouds offer richer structural information || regression and clustering (DBSCAN) for apple count estimation || using human-annotated section-level counts as reference ground truth show that regression achieves high accuracy (R2 ≈ 0.99, relative error ≤ 0.03)
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyatakan cara awan titik dibuat; frasa "UAV imagery" ditafsirkan sebagai fotogrametri dari banyak citra UAV (akuisisi D, M4). Bila ternyata LiDAR, akuisisi menjadi S. Regresi jumlah dikode M1; pengelompokan DBSCAN dalam ruang 3D dikode M4. Hitungan acuan dianotasi manusia per seksi, tidak jelas apakah di lapangan atau pada data.

judul: Horticultural temporal fruit monitoring via 3D instance segmentation and re-identification using colored point clouds
bukti_ai2: we introduce an attention-based matching network that associates fruits with their counterparts from previous sessions || It also exploits the relative position T ∈RB×3 between the query fruit and the fruits in Ft−1. || containing the same row of strawberries at 3 different points in time, each separated by approximately one week
catatan_ai2: Asosiasi antarwaktu, bukan penghapusan duplikat untuk pencacahan; tidak ada metrik hitung. Deskriptor 3D terpelajar (M2) dan posisi relatif 3D dengan batas jarak 0,05 m pada awan titik terdaftar (M4) menjadi masukan jaringan pencocok berbasis atensi (M5); M2 dapat diperdebatkan karena deskriptor dilatih bersama pencocok. Masukan berupa pemindaian laser (S), tetapi akuisisi dikodekan T karena kunjungan ulang adalah inti kajian. Metrik identitas berupa F1 pencocokan (F1p, F1n, mF1), bukan MOTA/IDF1.

judul: Cross-Day Grape Cluster Tracking Using Branch-Based 3D Alignment in Vineyards
bukti_ai2: Stable vine structures, such as trunks and main branches, are reconstructed using Structure from Motion, and their spatial correspondences are estimated through SIFT-based matching and similarity transformation. || the grape clusters detected by CenterNet are associated based on spatial proximity in the unified 3D space.
catatan_ai2: SIFT dipakai untuk menyelaraskan struktur cabang antarhari, bukan untuk mencocokkan buah, sehingga hanya M4. Abstrak tidak menyebut pembanding maupun metrik kuantitatif; teks lengkap tidak dapat diakses. Akuisisi tiap hari juga multipandang (SfM), tetapi ciri utamanya kunjungan ulang (T).

judul: Citrus yield estimation based on multi- object tracking in video streams using an improved YOLOv8n model
bukti_ai2: a cascaded matching strategy combining motion and appearance features for reliable identity association, and a track management system to assign unique IDs || The final fruit count was determined by the maximum unique ID assigned during the video sequence. || a handheld imaging system was used to capture 360° rotational video streams around 20 individual citrus trees
catatan_ai2: Isi kajian memenuhi C1 (DeepSORT pada video mengelilingi pohon). Kode X/E7 diberikan karena OpenAlex mencatat bahasa artikel zh (Journal of Fruit Science = Guoshu xuebao); hanya abstrak yang berbahasa Inggris. Apabila protokol menerima artikel berabstrak Inggris, kodenya C1. Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitungan; 'pohon' adalah dugaan dari konteks estimasi per pohon.

judul: Passion Fruit Counting Method Based on Lightweight YOLO lln CLL and BoT SORT
bukti_ai2: For object tracking, the BoT?SORT tracker was adopted, which incorporated a camera?motion?compensation module to mitigate camera?shake interference and improve tracking accuracy. || The region?based counting method yielded an average counting accuracy of 92.8% || achieved a HOTA of 62.4% and a MOTA of 68.4%
catatan_ai2: Kutipan verbatim dari abstrak Inggris di situs penerbit (tanda hubung tampil sebagai '?' pada sumber). BoT-SORT tanpa keterangan modul re-ID, sehingga M3 sesuai konvensi. Acuan hitung tidak dinyatakan di abstrak; anotasi video diasumsikan. Jurnal terbit dalam bahasa Tionghoa dengan abstrak Inggris; bila E7 diterapkan pada bahasa teks lengkap, rekaman ini menjadi X/E7.

judul: Enhanced grape tracking (using deep neural networks) with an extended matching algorithm for SORT and DeepSORT
bukti_ai2: evaluating the real-time tracking performance and counting accuracy of SORT, DeepSORT, ByteTrack, and the newly proposed SORT+ and DeepSORT+ algorithms || SORT+ and DeepSORT+ incorporate a novel matching cascade that leverages the complementary strengths of Mahalanobis, IoU, and Euclidean distances || SORT+ improves the counting accuracy from 33% to 96%
catatan_ai2: SORT+ tanpa re-ID (M3) dan DeepSORT+ dengan re-ID (M2+M3) sama-sama diusulkan; angka hitung 96% berasal dari SORT+, sehingga penghapus duplikat ditulis M3. Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitungan; anotasi video diasumsikan dari pemakaian MOTA dan IDF1.

judul: Tomato Maturity Classification and Fruit Counting Based on RGB and Multispectral Images †
bukti_ai2: the tracking module associates individual tomatoes across image sequences to avoid duplicate counting || We employ the tracking algorithm StrongSORT [29] for individual tomato tracking || Predictions from multiple frames were aggregated, and the class receiving the highest number of votes was selected as the final maturity label for each tomato.
catatan_ai2: StrongSORT dikodekan M2+M3 sesuai konvensi. Metrik identitas (MOTA, IDF1) tidak dilaporkan. Tanaman yang sama dipotret ulang tiap pekan, tetapi kunjungan ulang hanya dipakai untuk pelabelan kematangan, bukan untuk asosiasi buah. Akurasi klasifikasi dihitung dengan kotak ground truth, tanpa pelacak.

judul: Geo-Referenced Factor-Graph SLAM for Orchard-Scale 3D Apple Reconstruction and Yield Estimation
bukti_ai2: Apples are detected using a YOLO-based model and associated across frames via CoTracker3, enabling robust multi-view landmark reconstruction. || The pipeline produced Npred = 9739 landmarks versus NGT = 9985 apples, corresponding to an absolute error of 246 apples and an aggregate undercount of 2.46%. || The ground-truth value is established by physically harvesting the scanned orchard block and manually counting all collected fruits
catatan_ai2: Satu track CoTracker3 menjadi satu landmark 3D; hitungan adalah jumlah landmark sah, sehingga penghapus duplikat utama adalah pelacakan (M3), sedangkan triangulasi dan iSAM2 (M4) menyaring dan memperhalus landmark tanpa menggabungkannya. CoTracker3 adalah pelacak titik terlatih, dikodekan M3. Naskah mengakui tidak ada re-identifikasi setelah putar balik dan potensi hitung ganda dari dua sisi baris belum dievaluasi. Metrik pelacakan dihitung terhadap anotasi (253 identitas GT).

judul: LiDAR–Camera Fusion for 3D Fruit Counting and Density Mapping in Horizontal Trellis Orchards
bukti_ai2: The detected fruits were associated based on their estimated 3D coordinates within the SLAM-generated map, enabling the system to maintain consistent fruit identities || The association process employs a nearest-neighbor search, accelerated by a k-d tree [26], to find the closest existing instance || The system estimated a total of 1,963 fruits compared with the ground truth of 1,891 fruits
catatan_ai2: Abstrak menyebut 'temporal tracking', tetapi asosiasi dilakukan murni dengan jarak Euclid 3D (ambang 0,075 m) pada peta FAST-LIO2 dan rerata kumulatif posisi; naskah menyatakan pelacakan 2D antarframe tidak memadai, sehingga M3 tidak dikodekan. Akuisisi UGV berhenti-jalan dengan kamera RGB dan LiDAR pada lintasan bolak-balik bertumpang-tindih 50%; dikodekan V. Acuan hitung adalah anotasi manual pada peta awan titik berwarna, bukan hitungan di pohon.

judul: Citrus tracking and counting using UAV remote sensing video imagery with improved YOLO11
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] Proposes a citrus fruit tracking and counting method for UAV video streams that fuses a lightweight YOLO11-PMSL detector with a ByteTrack-DIoU algorithm. || [parafrasa web] A region-counting anti-jitter mechanism is embedded in ByteTrack-DIoU to resolve ID switches caused by occlusion. || [parafrasa web] Multi-object tracking accuracy rises 5.5, 5.7 and 4.3 points over SORT, DeepSORT and BoT-SORT; average tracking-count accuracy reaches 88.4%.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak (terjemahan dari bahasa Tionghoa) tidak menyebut acuan hitung; kode anotasi adalah dugaan (hitung manual pada video), karena pemeriksa tidak menerima nilai kosong. Naskah lengkap berbahasa Tionghoa dengan abstrak Inggris di jurnal; bila protokol menilai bahasa naskah, E7 perlu dipertimbangkan.

judul: PheMuT: A phenology-informed, multi-modal time-series model for strawberry yield forecasting
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] The model employs two YOLOv11 detectors, an optimized ByteTrack tracker, Segment Anything and Depth Anything v2 for fruit detection, canopy and volume estimation. || [parafrasa web] Across two cultivars and seasons, PheMuT reduces MAE by 10.7%, RMSE by 12.5%, and MAPE by 18.6% compared to manual baselines.
catatan_ai2: Hanya parafrasa abstrak yang terbaca. ByteTrack tidak memakai re-ID sehingga dikodekan M3. Akuisisi video disimpulkan dari pemakaian pelacak; data juga berupa deret waktu (kunjungan ulang, T). Parafrasa tidak menyebut apakah hitungan dilaporkan per tahap fenologi, sehingga per_kelas diisi N; rujukan panen disimpulkan dari tugas prakiraan hasil. Metrik pelacakan tidak disebut.

judul: Research on Lightweight Apple Detection and 3D Accurate Yield Estimation for Complex Orchard Environments
bukti_ai2: the CLV algorithm deeply integrates depth camera point cloud information through 3D coordinate mapping, irregular point cloud reconstruction, and convex hull volume calculation to achieve accurate estimation of individual fruit volume and total yield || The apple reconstruction and yield estimation results generated by the algorithm under each scenario were compared against the ground truth weights obtained after manual harvesting using a high-precision scale || Subsequent research could explore prior models for complete fruit shape based on partial observations or utilize multi-view information fusion to improve reconstruction completeness
catatan_ai2: Citra RGB-D diambil dari beberapa sudut, tetapi setiap citra diproses sendiri; tidak ada asosiasi antarpandang dan fusi multipandang disebut sebagai pekerjaan lanjutan, sehingga bukan C1. Estimasi hasil berupa massa per buah dari volume (galat 3,2% hingga 13,66%), bukan pencacahan.

judul: A real-time semantic 3D vineyard mapping and fruit localization system for yield estimation in dynamic vineyards
bukti_ai2: The proposed framework integrates the ORB-SLAM3 backend with a lightweight semantic segmentation model || followed by DBSCAN clustering and PCA-based modeling to extract the 3D location and quantity of grape bunches || The average counting error was 5.95%, demonstrating the system’s applicability for automated yield estimation.
catatan_ai2: Tandan dihitung dari klaster pada peta titik global hasil SLAM, sehingga duplikat antarframe dilebur secara geometris (M4). Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitung; 'pohon' (hitungan manual di kebun) adalah dugaan. Jenis sensor (RGB-D atau stereo) tidak disebut di abstrak.

judul: Proximal sensing of horticultural crops with mobile device LiDAR
bukti_ai2: a mobile device LiDAR sensor was used to collect 295 colorized point clouds of pepper, tomato, and watermelon plants || aboveground vegetative biomass, leaf and stem biomass, and leaf and stem number were physically measured in tomato and watermelon plants
catatan_ai2: Yang diukur adalah struktur vegetatif tanaman (tinggi, biomassa, jumlah daun dan batang); buah tidak dideteksi, dicacah, maupun diukur.

judul: Greenhouse Tomato Fruit Inspection and Counting Method Based on Improved YOLO v8n ByteTrack
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] Abstrak (terjemahan dari bahasa Tionghoa): metode pencacahan dinamis buah tomat rumah kaca dengan YOLO v8n yang diperbaiki dan ByteTrack berstrategi pencocokan ulang skor rendah adaptif. || [parafrasa web] Pencacahan memakai mekanisme pencocokan wilayah berurutan; pada 5 video rumah kaca MAE 1,4 dan akurasi hitung 96,6%, lebih baik daripada pencacahan garis dan wilayah.
catatan_ai2: Artikel terbit dalam bahasa Tionghoa (metadata penerbit DC.Language cn; hanya judul dan abstrak yang tersedia dalam bahasa Inggris), sehingga menurut protokol dikeluarkan dengan E7. Dari segi isi, kajian ini memenuhi C1 (pelacakan ByteTrack pada video, M3); bila artikel berbahasa Tionghoa dengan abstrak Inggris diterima, kodenya C1. Acuan hitung tidak dinyatakan dalam abstrak. referensi_hitung diisi "tidak ada" karena sumber yang terbaca tidak menyatakannya, bukan karena dipastikan tidak ada.

judul: Incremental 3D Crop Model Association for Real-Time Counting in Dense Orchards
bukti_ai2: we propose a real-time crop counting framework that incrementally constructs global 3D crop instances during data collection. || To ensure robust association across frames, we employ 3D Generalized Intersection over Union (GIoU) for spatial matching and confidence-based filtering for validation, effectively reducing double-counting in dense orchards.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut referensi hitung maupun metrik; 'tidak ada' pada referensi_hitung berarti tidak dinyatakan di abstrak, dan 'hitung' disimpulkan dari klaim akurasi pencacahan. Jenis sensor (kemungkinan RGB-D atau LiDAR) juga tidak disebut.

judul: Semantic NeRF-Oriented 3-D Object Counting for Industrial Fruit Harvesting
bukti_ai2: we propose a 3D object counting framework that integrates semantic Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) with a physics-guided adaptive clustering algorithm. || Thus, they suffer from the multi-view double-counting issue. || improves counting accuracy by an average of 9.0 percentage points (6.9 pp on synthetic, 7.2 pp on real-world, and 12.9 pp on Fuji)
catatan_ai2: Kode kelompok dan mekanisme jelas dari abstrak. Abstrak tidak menyebut pola akuisisi (citra multipandang diskret atau video; D dipilih karena NeRF memakai citra berpose) dan tidak menyebut acuan hitungan; 'anotasi' adalah dugaan.

judul: UAV-based monocular 3D panoptic mapping for fruit shape completion in orchard
bukti_ai2: The objective is to associate individual apples across 2D consecutive UAV-captured frames while maintaining high segmentation accuracy. || the foreground submaps of each apple entity were derived by accumulating the unprojected point cloud from multiple frames. || a total of 2729 individual apples were detected and reconstructed with our panoptic mapping method within row 1 under flight mode A.
catatan_ai2: Tujuan utama adalah pelengkapan bentuk dan ukuran buah, bukan pencacahan; jumlah 2.729 apel tidak dibandingkan dengan acuan apa pun. Identitas buah ditentukan ID pelacakan Grounded-SAM2 (M3); SfM (M4) dipakai untuk memproyeksikan piksel tiap ID ke kerangka dunia, bukan untuk menggabungkan duplikat. Pelacak SAM2 berbasis memori tampilan, tetapi sesuai konvensi dikode M3. Metrik ukuran (RMSE diameter, Chamfer distance) tidak tercakup dalam pilihan tingkat_metrik.

judul: CocoSense: AI-Powered Drone-Based System for Comprehensive Coconut Tree Health Monitoring and Yield Prediction
bukti_ai2: (4) coconut yield estimation (87.86% accuracy) using YOLOv8 with dual-view acquisition strategy. || a coconut bunch detection (88.96% accuracy) module is developed to support yield estimation by identifying fruit clusters within tree canopies.
catatan_ai2: Sebagian besar makalah membahas hama, penyakit, dan kesehatan daun (di luar cakupan); hanya modul keempat yang relevan. Abstrak menyebut akuisisi dua pandang tetapi tidak menyebut cara penggabungan atau penghapusan duplikat; M0 adalah dugaan dan dapat berupa M1. Acuan hitung tidak dinyatakan. Jika dua pandang ternyata diproses terpisah, kode menjadi C2.

judul: Vision-Based 3D Fruit Localization for Robotic Harvesting Using Recursive State Estimation

judul: Optimizing Fruit Yield Prediction: Evaluating Multiobject Tracking Algorithms for Calamansi Fruit Detection Using Yolov8m

catatan_ai2: M2 masuk karena DeepSORT ikut dievaluasi; konfigurasi terbaik (ByteTrack) adalah M3 murni. Abstrak tidak melaporkan galat hitung, hanya metrik identitas; referensi anotasi disimpulkan dari metrik MOT.

judul: Neural Radiance Fields for Plot-level Cotton Crop Three-dimensional Reconstruction and Yield Estimation
bukti_ai2: a novel Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based workflow was developed, integrating data acquisition, 3D reconstruction, and cotton boll mapping at the field-plot level || Finally, cotton boll counting for each plot was achieved using improved FruitNeRF. || the Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE) between the predicted and ground truth number of cotton bolls was 4.41%
catatan_ai2: Akuisisi memakai dua cara (deret 10 kamera pada platform robot dan video ponsel mengelilingi plot); dikodekan V. Abstrak tidak menyebut cara memperoleh jumlah acuan; kode pohon;panen disimpulkan dari frasa jumlah buah dan bobot buah acuan.

judul: Fruitgaussian: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Automated Fruit Counting in Natural Orchard
bukti_ai2: we propose FruitGaussian, a novel 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based framework for high-fidelity orchard scene understanding and fruit counting || Evaluations on real-world persimmon orchard datasets demonstrate a 96 % counting accuracy, surpassing Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF)-based methods by 16 %.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut cara akuisisi (video atau pandangan diskret) dan tidak menyebut acuan hitungan; akuisisi D dan referensi pohon adalah dugaan. Pencacahan dilakukan dari point cloud yang diekstrak dari representasi Gaussian, sehingga M4.

judul: Deep Learning-Based Coconut Ripeness Classification and Yield Estimation using YOLO and Kalman Filtering
bukti_ai2: employing YOLOv11 integrated with the Kalman Filter-Hungarian Algorithm, YOLOv8, and a custom-designed Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to accurately identify coconuts at three distinct ripeness stages || the proposed approach was extended to facilitate automated counting of coconuts using different tracking methodologies
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut akuisisi video secara eksplisit (V disimpulkan dari pelacakan Kalman-Hungarian), tidak menyebut acuan hitung, dan tidak menyatakan apakah hitungan dilaporkan per kelas kematangan. Dataset sumber terbuka; tidak jelas apakah kelapa berada di pohon.

judul: Multi-Object Tracking for Apple Counting in Orchards Using Stereo Vision
bukti_ai2: a 3D fruit counting framework based on stereo cameras in which each detection is localized within a georeferenced spatial coordinate system using GPS and visual odometry || To enable tracking across multiple consecutive frames, two state-of-the-art algorithms, OC-SORT and ByteTrack, are benchmarked against each other. || yielding an estimated total counting error of 20 apples, corresponding to a RMSE of 6.24 % and an R2 score of 0.96
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut sumber hitungan acuan; 'pohon' adalah dugaan dari frasa hitung per pohon. Abstrak juga tidak menjelaskan apakah duplikat dihapus oleh pelacakan, oleh posisi 3D bergeoreferensi, atau keduanya.

judul: CB-YOLO-DeepSORT: Real-Time Yield Estimation for Tomatoes in Greenhouses
bukti_ai2: the DeepSORT -based multi-object tracking algorithm is applied to continuously monitor tomatoes at different maturity stages, maintaining identity consistency || Real-time data is visualized through daily snapshots (pie charts and counts of ripe/unripe fruits)
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut pembanding hitungan maupun galat hitung. Kelas kematangan berasal dari detektor dan dibawa oleh lintasan DeepSORT; cara penetapan kelas per buah unik tidak dijelaskan, sehingga 'saat pelacakan' adalah tafsiran. Hitungan matang/mentah ditampilkan pada dasbor, bukan dievaluasi.

judul: Fruit Detection and Yield Estimation using Path Aggregation Feature Pyramid Network and Deep SORT Algorithm: A Case Study on Orange Fruit
bukti_ai2: Deep SORT provides robust tracking capabilities, utilizing motion and appearance descriptors to maintain consistent object identities across video frames, thereby minimizing counting errors. || The system successfully distinguishes between ripe and unripe oranges, visualizing separate yield counts with bounding box segmentation. || achieving 95.8% detection accuracy and 92.3% counting precision on the complex orange orchard dataset
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitungan secara eksplisit; 'anotasi' disimpulkan dari evaluasi pada dataset. Cara kelas dilekatkan pada identitas pelacak tidak dinyatakan.

judul: Fruit Detection and Yield Mass Estimation from a UAV Based RGB Dense Cloud for an Apple Orchard
bukti_ai2: Ripe apples were detected by their color and structure from a photogrammetrically created three-dimensional point cloud with an automatic algorithm. || For the imagery, 3D point clouds were calculated photogrammetrically for datasets from each flight setting using a specialized software tool (Metashape Professional || At an altitude of 7.5 m, a model fit with an R2 of around 0.41 was achieved.
catatan_ai2: Buah dideteksi langsung pada awan titik SfM (ambang warna HSV, DBSCAN, pencocokan bola), sehingga duplikat antarcitra hilang karena rekonstruksi bersama. Akuisisi berupa foto beruntun UAV sepanjang baris (tumpang-tindih 90-96%), bukan video; dikodekan V. Referensi massa adalah panen per blok; asal referensi jumlah apel per blok tidak dirinci (disebut data referensi manual).

judul: Research on fruit 3D point cloud segmentation based on improved YOLOv8
bukti_ai2: By extracting mask information, corresponding depth information is obtained, and the point cloud data corresponding to apples is obtained, providing assurance for the accuracy of subsequent localization. || the improved YOLOv8 model has higher instance segmentation accuracy, an increase of 4.2 percentage points
catatan_ai2: Modalitas RGB-D (masker ke awan titik apel), tetapi evaluasi yang dilaporkan abstrak hanya akurasi segmentasi instans 2D; lokalisasi 3D tidak dievaluasi. Alternatif yang masuk akal: X dengan alasan E5.

judul: YOLOv8-based Agricultural Robots for Precision Pollination and Yield Prediction
bukti_ai2: The system incorporates high-resolution cameras and IoT-enabled sensors to identify flowers, monitor pollinators, and evaluate fruit growth in real time. || average precision (AP) of 99.4% for flower identification and 98.7% for pollinator tracking || analyzed using a cloud-based machine learning framework, which facilitates yield prediction with 99.4% accuracy
catatan_ai2: Objek yang dideteksi dan dievaluasi adalah bunga dan penyerbuk, bukan buah. Prediksi hasil berasal dari model pembelajaran mesin di cloud dan abstrak tidak menyatakan adanya deteksi atau pencacahan buah. Apabila prediksi hasil dianggap estimasi hasil berbasis citra, kode alternatifnya C2.

judul: Development of an inventory and mapping system for oil palm fresh fruit bunch
bukti_ai2: develop a GIS integrated web-based inventory system for tracking oil palm fresh fruit bunch yields || The platform was developed using Google Sites, integrates interactive mapping tools such as Mapbox
catatan_ai2: Sistem inventaris berbasis peta web dan kalkulator hasil tanpa metode berbasis citra; tidak ada alasan eksklusi yang tepat sama, E3 dipilih sebagai yang terdekat (hasil dicatat tanpa mendeteksi buah).

judul: Autonomous UAV Navigation and Mapping for Accurate Fruit Detection and Counting in Controlled Environments: Simulation and Real-World Validation
bukti_ai2: The solution is further extended to the real-life scenario using LiDAR based mapping and point-cloud filtering techniques to avoid recounting of fruits. || achieving a fruitcount accuracy of 98 % and 90 % respectively
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyatakan pola akuisisi (pandangan diskret atau video), acuan hitung, dan apakah hitungan dilaporkan per kelas buah; akuisisi D dan referensi pohon adalah dugaan dari konteks kompetisi rumah kaca.

judul: FruitNeRF++: A Generalized Multi-Fruit Counting Method Utilizing Contrastive Learning and Neural Radiance Fields
bukti_ai2: The masks are used to encode the identity of each fruit as instance embeddings into a neural instance field. || By volumetrically sampling the neural fields, we extract a point cloud embedded with the instance features, which can be clustered in a fruit-agnostic manner to obtain the fruit count. || combines contrastive learning with neural radiance fields to count fruits from unstructured input photographs of orchards
catatan_ai2: Identitas buah ditetapkan di ruang 3D bersama (NeRF, M4) melalui embedding instans yang dilatih secara kontrastif lalu dikelompokkan dengan HDBSCAN (jarak Euclid dan kosinus); komponen terlatih ini dikode M5, meskipun dapat pula dibaca sebagai M4 saja. Hitungan dilaporkan per jenis buah pada adegan terpisah, bukan per kelas atribut, sehingga per_kelas N. Acuan hitung adalah data sintetis beranotasi dan anotasi set Fuji. Nomor halaman mengacu pada PDF arXiv.

judul: Agtech Framework for Cranberry-Ripening Analysis Using Vision Foundation Models
bukti_ai2: using ground-based imaging (hand-held camera), we image same bog patch using fixed fiducial markers || Ground imaging enables tracking of individual berries for a detailed view of berry appearance changes. || [parafrasa web] Citra deret waktu diregistrasi ke citra pertama dengan SIFT dan homografi RANSAC; segmentasi buah memakai SAM 2 dengan klik titik.
catatan_ai2: Kajian mengaitkan buah yang sama antarkunjungan, tetapi tujuannya analisis pematangan, bukan pencacahan; kelayakan bergantung pada tafsir 'links fruit across images'. Identitas buah diperoleh dari registrasi citra (kerangka koordinat bersama) dan klik manual, sehingga M4 dipilih; penghapusan duplikat tidak relevan. Rasio kematangan dilaporkan sebagai persentase buah merah, bukan hitungan per kelas. Rincian metode berasal dari ringkasan WebFetch, bukan kutipan yang saya baca langsung.

judul: PineSORT: A Simple Online Real-Time Tracking Framework for Drone Videos in Agriculture
bukti_ai2: PineSORT enhances the tracking accuracy with motion direction cost, camera motion compensation, a three-stage association strategy, and overlap management. || a novel Multiple Object Tracking (MOT) system for drone-based agricultural monitoring, specifically tracking pineapples for yield estimation || we manually annotated the dataset using LabelStudio
catatan_ai2: Makalah hanya mengevaluasi metrik identitas terhadap anotasi MOT; galat hitung tidak dilaporkan. ORB dipakai untuk kompensasi gerak kamera, bukan pencocokan penampilan buah, sehingga dikodekan M3. Asosiasi berbasis IoU dan DIoU tiga tahap.

judul: An Object-Tracking Technique for Counting Grape Clusters in Brazilian Northeast's Pergola Vineyards
bukti_ai2: combines object detection (YOLOv8) and tracking (ByteTrack) to count grape clusters in handheld smartphone videos captured under diverse environmental conditions || achieving $75.1 \% \text{mAP} {@} 50$ and a 69.9 % F1-score for cluster detection, with a final cluster count only 27 % above the actual value
catatan_ai2: Abstrak hanya menyebut 'actual value' tanpa menjelaskan apakah itu hitungan tangan di kebun atau anotasi video; referensi pohon adalah dugaan. Kode kelompok dan mekanisme (ByteTrack = M3) tidak diragukan.

judul: Real-Time Fruit Detection and Counting
bukti_ai2: propose a system based on cutting-edge technologies, YOLOv8 and ByteTrack, to accurately detect and count fruits in real time || The comparison between the manual counting and the model showed an accuracy of 75.33 %.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyatakan apakah buah berada di pohon, apakah pencacahan manual dilakukan pada video atau di lapangan, dan apakah hitungan dilaporkan per jenis buah (20 kelas adalah jenis buah, bukan atribut kematangan).

judul: Spatio-Temporal Metric-Semantic Mapping for Persistent Orchard Monitoring: Method and Dataset
bukti_ai2: We present a 4D spatio-temporal metric-semantic mapping system that integrates multi-session measurements to track fruit growth over time. || combines a LiDAR-RGB fusion module for 3D fruit localization with a 4D fruit association method leveraging positional, visual, and topology information || our method achieves a 96.9% fruit counting accuracy for 1,790 apples across 60 trees
catatan_ai2: Keputusan C1 berkeyakinan tinggi; yang ragu adalah rinciannya. Abstrak tidak menyatakan referensi hitung (diduga hitung di pohon) dan tidak memisahkan mekanisme penghapus duplikat dalam satu sesi dari asosiasi antarsesi; informasi visual ditafsirkan sebagai M2, posisi dan topologi sebagai M4. Akuisisi juga memuat LiDAR (S) dalam tiap sesi.

judul: Performance Evaluation of Detection and Tracking Algorithms for Automated Grape Cluster Counting
bukti_ai2: two detection methods-YOLOv12 and RF-DETR-were compared in combination with two tracking algorithms-BoTSORT and ByteTrack-to generate four distinct configurations aimed at the automatic counting of grape clusters || Experimental results on a video dataset recorded in agroindustrial vineyards showed that the combination of YOLOv12 with BoT-SORT achieved the highest average relative counting accuracy, with 84.31%.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyatakan apakah BoT-SORT dipakai dengan modul re-ID, sehingga dikodekan M3 sesuai konvensi. Acuan hitung tidak dinyatakan di abstrak; anotasi adalah dugaan dari frasa akurasi hitung relatif pada dataset video. Abstrak tidak menyebut metrik identitas.

judul: Optimizing Fruit Harvesting Through a High-Performance Deep Learning Framework for Detection, Tracking, and Automated Counting.
bukti_ai2: Utilizing the cutting-edge YOLO V7 for detection and integrating it with DeepSORT and an ROI line-based method for counting || The YOLO-V7 model demonstrated exceptional efficacy in fruit detection, achieving a mean average precision (mAP@0.50) of 97.5%.
catatan_ai2: DeepSORT dikodekan M2+M3 menurut konvensi; garis ROI termasuk M3. Abstrak tidak menyebut jenis buah, apakah buah berada di pohon, maupun pembanding hitungan; referensi_hitung dan tingkat_metrik diisi dari abstrak saja.

judul: YOLOv8 vs. SSD for Apple Detection in Agriculture: Performance, Overlap Handling and Volume Estimation
bukti_ai2: This paper presents two apple recognition models based on YOLOv8 and Single Shot MultiBox Detector (SSD) algorithms respectively and compares their performance under identical conditions. || Additionally, we derived a formula to estimate apple volume using camera parameters and field-of-view data.
catatan_ai2: Evaluasi hanya pada deteksi satu kelas; rumus volume diturunkan tetapi abstrak tidak melaporkan evaluasinya. Apabila teks lengkap mengevaluasi estimasi volume, kode yang lebih tepat adalah C2 atau C5.

judul: Maturity detection and counting of blueberries in real orchards using a 1novel STF-YOLO model integrated with ByteTrack algorithm
bukti_ai2: ByteTrack efficiently links detected blueberry instances across frames, making it particularly effective in high-density scenarios with overlapping fruits and frequent occlusions. || The actual number of blueberries at each growth stage was obtained through manual counting during video collection. || When combined with ByteTrack, it attained an average counting accuracy of 72.49% across blue, purple, and green maturity classes in video sequences.
catatan_ai2: Metode utama ByteTrack (M3); OC-SORT (M3) dan StrongSORT (M2+M3) hanya pembanding. Naskah tidak menjelaskan cara label kematangan ditetapkan per lintasan (kelas berasal dari detektor per frame), dan tidak melaporkan metrik identitas (MOTA, IDF1). Hitungan acuan adalah hitung manual saat perekaman video.

judul: Automated Muskmelon Counting in Real Farm Environment using YOLOv11n
bukti_ai2: a robust computer vision pipeline for accurately detecting, tracking, and counting melons using the You Only Look Once version 11 nano object detection model || front row strict annotation and line counting tracking combination which yielded a counting error rate of just 2.74% || The system was tested on footage captured by an automated guide vehicle in a greenhouse
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut nama pelacak maupun modul re-ID, sehingga dikodekan M3 (pelacakan dengan garis hitung). Acuan cacah tidak dinyatakan di abstrak; "anotasi" adalah dugaan dan perlu diperiksa pada teks lengkap.

judul: An Apple Counting System Robust to Multiple Intermittent Occlusions
bukti_ai2: we present a novel method to detect, track and count fruits that is scalable and robust towards problems existing in other fruit counting methods || (1) a stereo camera that can be used reliably under direct sunlight, (2) a fast detection algorithm, and (3) an algorithmic approach to track fruits which is robust to fruit occlusions || We applied our proposed solution in an apple orchard and were able to provide apple counts with an error ranging from 15% to 57%.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak merinci algoritma pelacakan; kamera stereo mungkin dipakai untuk asosiasi 3D (M3+M4), tetapi hal itu tidak dinyatakan. Acuan hitung tidak disebut dalam abstrak; pohon disimpulkan dari galat hitung di kebun. Akuisisi V disimpulkan dari kamera pada traktor.

judul: Hierarchical 3D Scene Graph based Semantic-Metric SLAM for Plant Inspection and Fruit Counting in Intelligent Hydroponics System
bukti_ai2: this study proposes a three dimensional Scene Graph (3DSG)-based hierarchical mapping method for the dynamic monitoring of plant and fruit growth || The system is validated through simulations and real-world experiments, providing a quantitative evaluation of object pose estimation
catatan_ai2: Pencacahan buah hanya disebut pada judul; abstrak tidak melaporkan metrik hitung maupun referensi hitung. Mekanisme M4 disimpulkan dari SLAM dan peta 3D; teks lengkap tidak tersedia.

judul: IoT-Based Precision Litchi Tracking and Counting Method Using Gated Metrics
bukti_ai2: This study presents a novel tracking and counting method called LitchiCount, integrating the multi-object tracking detection model LitchiDet with a counting module || We propose a Distance-generalized Intersection over Union association metric using a gating mechanism(DG-GM) and an AreaC counting strategy tailored to field intricate scenes.
catatan_ai2: Asosiasi berbasis tumpang-tindih dan jarak kotak (M3) dengan wilayah hitung; abstrak tidak menyebut fitur penampilan. Referensi hitung dan metrik tidak dinyatakan di abstrak; 'anotasi' dan 'hitung;deteksi' adalah inferensi dari frasa 'in detection and counting'.

judul: Advancing tracking-by-detection with MultiMap: Towards occlusion-resilient online multiclass strawberry counting
bukti_ai2: By utilizing tracking-by-detection algorithms, this system is able to trace multiple fruits from their first appearance to their final disappearance in real-time footage. || segregates and tallies each strawberry class, presenting multiclass counts to the users. Within prevalent tracking frameworks, our approach records a mere 6.7% relative counting error rate. || [parafrasa web] README repositori MultiMap menyatakan metode dibangun di atas pelacak tracking-by-detection StrongSORT dan ByteTrack.
catatan_ai2: M2 dicantumkan karena StrongSORT memakai fitur penampilan (konvensi), sedangkan ByteTrack hanya M3; abstrak sendiri tidak menyebut nama pelacak. Abstrak tidak menyebut cara penetapan kelas per lintasan, acuan hitung (diduga anotasi video), maupun metrik identitas.

judul: StraTracker: A dynamic counting method for growing strawberries based on multi-target tracking
catatan_ai2: Kode kelompok jelas dari judul (penghitungan dengan pelacakan multi-target). Rincian C1 tidak dapat diverifikasi: komponen penampilan (M2), hitungan per kelas ('growing strawberries' mungkin menyangkut tahap pertumbuhan), referensi hitung, dan metrik tidak diketahui; nilai 'tidak ada' berarti tidak diketahui, bukan dinyatakan tidak ada.

judul: Automatic Apple Detection and Counting with AD-YOLO and MR-SORT
bukti_ai2: each apple in the video is given a different ID value, and the maximum ID value corresponds to the number of apples in the video || we add the VLAD module after the first and second IoU-based matching || In multiple matching, fruit appearance features, Mahalanobis distance, and IoU measure are integrated to match the target frame by frame
catatan_ai2: BoT-SORT versi dasar (tanpa ReID) dipakai sebagai M3; M2 berasal dari pencocokan ulang SURF+VLAD yang ditambahkan penulis. Nilai acuan berasal dari anotasi video dataset publik (Villacres dkk.), disebut penulis sebagai nilai hitung manual.

judul: Multi-Object Tracking in Agricultural Applications using a Vision Transformer for Spatial Association
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] Kerangka pelacakan multiobjek untuk pertanian yang mengestimasi posisi global dalam koordinat piksel memakai transformer pencocokan fitur lokal LoFTR. || [parafrasa web] Pelacak mutakhir ditambah strategi asosiasi berbasis informasi spasial target yang keluar dan kembali ke bidang pandang kamera. || [parafrasa web] Dievaluasi pada LettuceMOT dan AppleMOT (adaptasi AppleMOTS); peningkatan rata-rata hingga 25% pada LettuceMOT.
catatan_ai2: Objek utama adalah tanaman selada; buah (apel) hanya pada set AppleMOT, dan tidak ada evaluasi hitungan, hanya metrik pelacakan. LoFTR adalah pencocok terlatih yang dipakai untuk registrasi citra ke kerangka koordinat bersama sehingga dikodekan M4; M5 dapat diperdebatkan. Pelacak dasar tidak disebut dalam parafrasa (dianggap M3). Dapat pula dibaca sebagai T bila pohon apel tidak dianggap inti.

judul: On-Tree Mango Fruit Count Using Live Video-Split Image Dataset to Predict Better Yield at Pre-Harvesting Stage
bukti_ai2: We strategically selected representative frames from the different segments by capturing a 360-degree video around the tree and splitting it into individual frames to avoid double counting. || At the corner, mangoes will counted twice; to avoid this problem, we used an eight-sided model (Eq. (5)). || FTM is the frame's total mango count, and FCM is the corner mango of the frame.
catatan_ai2: Hitungan delapan bingkai dijumlahkan; duplikat dicegah lewat pemilihan bingkai dan pengurangan kelas deteksi 'Corner-Mango' (Pers. 5 tidak terbaca di teks), tanpa pencocokan buah antarbingkai, sehingga dikodekan M0. Naskah menyebut SORT/DeepSORT di bagian metode, tetapi hasil yang dilaporkan berasal dari delapan bingkai diskret, bukan pelacakan. Kelas Hidden/Mango/Corner hanya ditampilkan untuk satu bingkai (Gambar 4), bukan hitungan per kelas pada hasil.

judul: Multiple orange detection and tracking with 3-D fruit relocalization and neural-net based yield regression in commercial sweet orange orchards
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] Abstrak arXiv: inter-frame association techniques are applied to track the fruits across frames; a relocalization component employs 3-D estimation of fruit locations for occluded and re-appeared fruit. || [parafrasa web] Abstrak arXiv: with at least 30% of the fruit detected, tracked and counted, the yield regressor achieves a coefficient of determination of 0.85; manual fruit counting is the reference. || [parafrasa web] Dataset beranotasi MOrangeT (pelacakan) dan OranDet (deteksi) dirilis publik.
catatan_ai2: Bukti berasal dari abstrak pracetak arXiv, bukan versi jurnal. Regresi hasil dengan jaringan saraf bersifat koreksi statistik atas hitungan (mirip M1), tetapi duplikat dihapus oleh pelacakan dan relokalisasi 3D. Metrik identitas diduga dari adanya dataset pelacakan MOrangeT; abstrak tidak menyebut nama metriknya. C2 tidak sepenuhnya cocok; dicantumkan hanya karena estimasi hasil.

judul: Assessing a multi-camera system to enhance fruit visibility for robotic harvesting in a V-trellised apple orchard
bukti_ai2: This study assesses the efficacy of utilizing multiple cameras at varying elevations and azimuthal angles to enhance fruit visibility. || a single camera whose optical axis was perpendicular to the canopy could detect up to 88.3% of the fruits detected by four cameras.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut cara menyatukan deteksi buah yang sama antarkamera; M4 adalah dugaan dari susunan kamera berposisi tetap dan perlu diperiksa pada teks lengkap. Acuan pembanding adalah jumlah buah unik hasil gabungan empat kamera, bukan hitungan lapangan. Tujuan utama adalah visibilitas untuk robot panen, bukan estimasi hasil.

judul: SLAM-PYE: Tightly coupled GNSS-binocular-inertial fusion for pitaya positioning, counting, and yield estimation
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] Sistem menggabungkan secara erat pengukuran mentah GNSS dwifrekuensi dan data visual-inersial untuk mengestimasi posisi dan radius buah naga, lalu hasil rumah kaca. || [parafrasa web] Sistem memberi estimasi hasil buah naga yang waktu nyata, tidak berulang (non-repetitive), dan sedikit terlewat.
catatan_ai2: Abstrak verbatim tidak diperoleh. Acuan hitungan dan angka metrik tidak diketahui; 'tidak ada' berarti tidak dinyatakan pada sumber yang terbaca, bukan pasti tidak ada. Penghapusan duplikat disimpulkan dari posisi buah pada kerangka koordinat bersama.

judul: Palm fruit harvesting using IoT-based fruit counting system
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak ditemukan. Judul tidak menyatakan apakah pencacahan memakai citra atau sensor IoT nonpencitraan; bila bukan sensor pencitraan, kode yang tepat adalah X dengan alasan E6. Modalitas RGB adalah dugaan.

judul: Predicting Grape Yield with Vine Canopy Morphology Analysis from 3D Point Clouds Generated by UAV Imagery
bukti_ai2: This study’s main goals were to gather canopy morphology data using a sophisticated 3D model and assess how well different morphology characteristics predicted yield results. || According to the study, the best combination for predicting grape production was the side section and thickness.
catatan_ai2: Hasil panen dimodelkan dari morfologi kanopi (ketebalan, penampang sisi, volume, luas permukaan) pada model 3D UAV; buah tidak dideteksi.

judul: GrapeMOTS: UAV vineyard dataset with MOTS grape bunch annotations recorded from multiple perspectives for enhanced object detection and tracking
bukti_ai2: The same ID was maintained for grape bunches seen from different perspectives to enhance Object Tracking. || A total of 11 vineyard videos were annotated using CVAT software in MOTS style for grape bunch Detection and Tracking. || The dataset, totalling 78.8 GB excluding the original videos, includes 5958 labelled frames.
catatan_ai2: Makalah data tanpa metode asosiasi dan tanpa evaluasi; anotasi identitas tandan tersedia sebagai kebenaran dasar pelacakan.

judul: A passion fruit counting method based on the lightweight YOLOv5s and improved DeepSORT
bukti_ai2: the information obtained from the detection model is input into improved DeepSORT for continuous frame tracking of passion fruit || to overcome the problem of repetitive counting, a specific tracking counting method based on the track information and state is used for accurate passion fruit counting || The counting results from test videos are highly correlated with the manual counting results
catatan_ai2: Kutipan verbatim dari abstrak di halaman Springer. DeepSORT dikodekan M2+M3 sesuai konvensi. Abstrak tidak menyatakan apakah hitungan manual dilakukan pada video atau di kebun; ditafsirkan sebagai hitungan manual pada video uji (anotasi).

judul: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping System for Agricultural Yield Estimation Based on Improved VINS-RGBD: A Case Study of a Strawberry Field

Sumber menyebut 'actual number of fruits' tanpa merinci cara penghitungannya; ditafsirkan sebagai hitung manual pada tanaman. Segmentasi juga dinilai dengan mIoU (bukan metrik deteksi mAP/F1).

judul: Advanced methods for yield mapping in tart cherries: tank change tracking and YOLO-DeepSort fruit counting

catatan_ai2: Mekanisme mengikuti konvensi DeepSORT (M2+M3). Akuisisi video disimpulkan dari pemakaian pelacak; abstrak tidak menyebut cara akuisisi maupun pembanding hitungan. Metode pertama (tank change tracking) bukan pencitraan.

judul: Fruit yield estimation and forecasting for precision agriculture
bukti_ai2: Fruit yield estimation is performed on video footage in which fruits are detected and tracked in each frame of the input video. || DeepSORT algorithm is used for tracking the fruits. || By keeping track of the fruits throughout the video frames, it is ensured that we are estimating the total fruit count appropriately when they are detected.
catatan_ai2: DeepSORT dikodekan M2+M3 menurut konvensi. Abstrak tidak memuat metrik maupun pembanding hitungan, sehingga referensi_hitung dan tingkat_metrik diisi 'tidak ada' berdasarkan abstrak saja; jenis buah tidak disebut.

judul: UAVEC-FLchain: Distributed multi-regional jujube orchard joint yield estimation for secure agricultural-IoT applications
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak ditemukan. Judul menunjukkan estimasi hasil kebun jujube dengan UAV, komputasi tepi, pembelajaran terfederasi, dan blockchain; diasumsikan deteksi buah per citra. Bila estimasi hasil ternyata tanpa deteksi buah, kodenya X/E3.

judul: Camellia oleifera Fruit Static and Dynamic Detection Counting Based on Improved COF-YOLO v8n
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] Dynamic counting draws on the multi-target tracking idea of DeepSORT algorithm, and took the recognition output of COF-YOLO v8n as the input of DeepSORT to realize the recognition and counting of Camellia oleifera fruits. || [parafrasa web] COF-YOLO v8n dengan DeepSORT menghitung 798 buah terhadap 987 hitungan manual (81,9%); isi makalah berbahasa Mandarin dengan abstrak bahasa Inggris.
catatan_ai2: Isi makalah berbahasa Mandarin (jurnal Nongye Jixie Xuebao), hanya abstrak yang berbahasa Inggris, sehingga dikeluarkan dengan E7. Secara substansi kajian ini memenuhi C1 (pencacahan video dengan DeepSORT, M2+M3 menurut konvensi). Hitungan manual dirata-ratakan dari tiga kali penghitungan; sumber tidak menjelaskan apakah penghitungan dilakukan pada video atau di pohon, sehingga referensi diisi anotasi.

judul: Maturity Recognition and Fruit Counting for Sweet Peppers in Greenhouses Using Deep Learning Neural Networks
bukti_ai2: we integrated DeepSORT for counting, providing estimates of the pepper count in a greenhouse lane. || First, we use the DeepSORT method to find suitable tracks based on their movement and appearance. || These photos were strategically arranged horizontally, creating the visual effect of a robot navigating through the sweet pepper lanes in the greenhouse
catatan_ai2: Video dibuat dengan menyusun 70 foto diam menjadi video simulasi, bukan rekaman video lapangan. Kelas kematangan ditetapkan detektor per deteksi, tetapi jumlah per kelas tidak dilaporkan; hasil pelacakan hanya MOTA, FP, FN, dan IDS. Angka akurasi hitung 85,7% hanya muncul di abstrak dan simpulan tanpa tabel hitungan.

judul: A robust and efficient citrus counting approach for large-scale unstructured orchards
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak ditemukan. Judul hanya memastikan pencacahan jeruk di kebun; tidak dapat dipastikan apakah pencacahan memakai pelacakan video (C1) atau citra tunggal (C2). Perlu diperiksa manusia pada teks lengkap.

judul: A Seamless Deep Learning Approach for Apple Detection, Depth Estimation, and Tracking Using YOLO Models Enhanced by Multi-Head Attention Mechanism
bukti_ai2: a reliable method is to use an object tracking mechanism to follow each apple during the course of the video until the counter is incremented || ByteTrack tracked the apples between frames solely by predicting their movements, using bounding boxes that were computed using the Kalman filter, eliminating the need for ReID || compare the counting accuracy of the automated system with the manually recorded results
catatan_ai2: ByteTrack dipakai tanpa ReID (dinyatakan di Diskusi), sehingga M3; DeepSORT hanya pembanding. Hitungan manual dilakukan pada sekuens video, bukan di pohon. Kedalaman dari kamera stereo ditampilkan per apel tetapi tidak dievaluasi, sehingga C5 tidak dicantumkan. MOTA didefinisikan tetapi nilainya tidak dilaporkan.

judul: An improved framework based on tracking-by-detection for simultaneous estimation of yield and maturity level in cherry tomatoes
catatan_ai2: Kode kelompok C1 jelas dari judul (tracking-by-detection untuk estimasi hasil). Rincian mekanisme (M3 atau M2+M3), per_kelas, pembanding hitungan, dan metrik adalah dugaan dari judul dan perlu teks lengkap.

judul: Approach of Dynamic Tracking and Counting for Obscured Citrus in Smart Orchard Based on Machine Vision
bukti_ai2: the DeepSORT algorithm [18] added Re-ID appearance features || The Hungarian algorithm is used to match the same fruit inconsecutive video frames || fruit counting was achieved by a drawing lines counting strategy, combining the identity ID assigned to each citrus
catatan_ai2: Makalah menyebut DeepSORT (gerak dan penampilan) sehingga M2+M3 menurut konvensi; uraian pencocokan yang dirinci hanya jarak Euclid dan IoU dengan Kalman filter dan algoritma Hungarian, sehingga peran fitur penampilan tidak diuraikan. Referensi hitung adalah hitung manual pada video, bukan pada pohon. MOTA dan MOTP didefinisikan tidak baku (rasio kecocokan).

judul: Eggplant Detection and Counting Across the Entire Greenhouse Using Deep Learning and Motion Parallax
bukti_ai2: we propose a method for accurately counting the number of eggplants in an agricultural greenhouse by using an object detection model and an object tracking model || Our method utilizes the principle of motion parallax to prevent double counting and ensure accurate counts of each ridge || The proposed method was evaluated using object tracking metrics and a comparison with the actual fruit count
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut nama pelacak dan tidak memuat angka. Paralaks gerak ditafsirkan sebagai isyarat gerak pada lintasan pelacakan (M3), bukan asosiasi 3D eksplisit; bila teks lengkap memakai kedalaman atau posisi 3D, kode menjadi M3+M4. Referensi hitung 'actual fruit count' ditafsirkan sebagai hitung pada tanaman.

judul: FruitNeRF: A Unified Neural Radiance Field based Fruit Counting Framework
bukti_ai2: Our framework takes an unordered set of posed images captured by a monocular camera and segments fruit in each image. || By applying cascaded clustering on the extracted point cloud, our approach achieves precise fruit count. || The real-world dataset consists of three apple trees with manually counted ground truths, a benchmark apple dataset with one row and ground truth fruit location
catatan_ai2: Akuisisi dikodekan D karena masukannya himpunan citra berpose tak berurutan; cara perekaman di lapangan tidak dinyatakan di abstrak. Referensi anotasi merujuk pada lokasi buah acuan pada dataset benchmark dan data sintetis. Abstrak tidak memuat angka hasil.

judul: Apple Detection and Counting Using Neural Networks
bukti_ai2: Three tracking algorithms (StrongSort, ByteTrack and OCSort) were tested using the trained models and labeled video datasets. || two fitting models based on linear regression were evaluated in order to minimize prediction errors || the performance of OCSort stands out, reaching a HOTA metric of 60.24%
catatan_ai2: M2 berasal dari StrongSort (penampilan + gerak) yang ikut diuji; pelacak terbaik OCSort adalah M3. Regresi linear sebagai koreksi hitungan dikode M1. Abstrak tidak menyebut angka galat hitung maupun apakah ada hitung manual di pohon; referensi dikode anotasi dari "labeled video datasets" (video kebun nyata dan simulator ROS).

judul: Deep Neural Network Based Yield Phenotyping Framework: Fruit Grading and Classification
bukti_ai2: Deep learning models predict the fruit grade, and the system's conveyor belt sort the fruits into baskets based on their grade. || The primary objective of this research paper is to establish a real-time, non-destructive system that automates fruit segmentation, grading and classification.
catatan_ai2: Pemilahan buah lepas panen di atas konveyor; bukan buah di pohon dan bukan sawit.

judul: Maturity and Yield Estimation of Tomatoes Using RGB and Multispectral Images
bukti_ai2: The tomatoes are identified using object detection and tracking networks, followed by ripeness classification into the categories “mature”, “almost mature” and “immature”. || the image sequence is used to detect tomatoes, and assign an ID to each of them || tomato tracking and maturity classification are integrated, and the number of tomatoes with various maturity in each group is counted
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut nama pelacak, sehingga dikodekan M3 (tidak diketahui ada tidaknya modul re-ID). Abstrak juga tidak menyebut acuan cacah maupun metrik; referensi_hitung dan tingkat_metrik diisi 'tidak ada' atas dasar itu dan perlu diperiksa pada teks lengkap. C5 hanya cocok bila deteksi dengan citra multispektral dievaluasi.

judul: StableSort-CMC: a tracking algorithm for robot dog based orchard fruit counting
bukti_ai2: this paper proposes a tracking algorithm integrated with a camera motion compensation module || This module applies image rotation, scaling, and translation parameters to the tracking algorithm, enhancing its performance and counting accuracy in vibrated scenes. || the proposed algorithm achieves a Multiple Object Tracking Accuracy (MOTA) of 63.4%
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut apakah pelacak memakai fitur penampilan (re-ID), sehingga dikodekan M3 saja. Abstrak menyebut akurasi hitung tetapi hanya melaporkan MOTA; angka galat hitung dan pembanding hitungan tidak dinyatakan (referensi anotasi disimpulkan dari MOTA).

judul: An In-Field Dynamic Vision-Based Analysis for Vineyard Yield Estimation
bukti_ai2: a SiamFC-based tracking mechanism is employed to estimate the number of unique bunches per panel or row || solutions able to consider temporal information captured across sequential frames are currently poorly developed || achieving harvested weight errors of less than 5% in two of the three vineyard panels
catatan_ai2: SiamFC adalah pelacak berbasis kemiripan penampilan (jaringan Siamese) yang dijalankan antarframe berurutan, sehingga dikodekan M2+M3; abstrak tidak merinci aturan asosiasi. Abstrak tidak melaporkan metrik identitas.

judul: Enabling Consumer UAVs for Precision Agriculture Applications: A Case Study of Yield Estimation
bukti_ai2: The processing pipeline consists of preprocessing, object detection, and yield estimation. || The object detector, being the most computationally expensive module, is invoked every nth frame due to video redundancy and the target platform’s limited resources.
catatan_ai2: Masukan berupa video UAV, tetapi abstrak tidak menyebut pelacakan atau langkah asosiasi antarframe; detektor hanya dipanggil setiap frame ke-n. Bila teks lengkap ternyata memuat pelacakan atau penghapusan duplikat, kode yang tepat adalah C1.

judul: Tracking and Counting Apples in Orchards under Intermittent Occlusions and Low Frame Rates
bukti_ai2: Here we show that combining Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with a bipartite graph matching has the potential to address those challenges. || we track the fruits across images by solving a sequence of linear assignment problems between labelled 3D points and the detections in each image || we have to manually assign a unique fruit ID to each bounding box in the video, thus effectively performing fruit tracking by hand
catatan_ai2: Asosiasi murni geometris: titik 3D buah (COLMAP, peta kedalaman) diproyeksikan ulang ke bingkai, lalu penugasan Hungarian atas jumlah titik dalam kotak deteksi; tanpa fitur penampilan dan tanpa model gerak, sehingga dikodekan M4 saja. Hasil utama memakai anotasi sebagai deteksi (deteksi sempurna). Nomor halaman adalah posisi halaman pada PDF CVF, bukan berkas lokal.

judul: NTrack: A Multiple-Object Tracker and Dataset for Infield Cotton Boll Counting
bukti_ai2: NTrack computes dense optical flow and utilizes particle filtering to guide each tracker. || we propose a relative location-based re-identification technique that can handle significant changes in appearance due to long-spanning occlusions. || Cgt and Ch are the number of unique cotton bolls detected manually (i.e., the ground truth) and by NTrack in the ith video sequence
catatan_ai2: Reidentifikasi memakai lokasi relatif terhadap lintasan tetangga dalam koordinat citra, bukan deskriptor penampilan dan bukan kerangka 3D, sehingga dikodekan M3 saja. Naskah juga merilis dataset video TexCot22.

judul: A model to predict the fruit bearing capacity of individual apple trees and its variability within commercial orchards
bukti_ai2: In der vorliegenden Arbeit wurde ein Ansatz entwickelt, um die Fruchtertragskapazität von allen Bäumen einer Anlage in Relation zu Blattfläche, Zielfruchtgröße und saisonaler Witterung zu modellieren. || Zur Validierung des Modells wurde die Fruchtanzahl an Einzelbäumen (n = 106) gezählt und die Fruchtgrößenverteilung baumweise bestimmt.
catatan_ai2: Kapasitas buah dimodelkan dari luas daun hasil LiDAR dan data cuaca; buah dihitung manual, tidak dideteksi dari citra. Halaman penerbit menunjukkan naskah berbahasa Jerman, sehingga E7 juga mungkin berlaku; bahasa teks lengkap tidak diperiksa langsung.

judul: Enhancing Orchard Cultivation Through Drone Technology and Deep Stream Algorithms in Precision Agriculture

catatan_ai2: Abstrak menggambarkan pemantauan kebun delima secara umum (kesehatan tanaman, penyakit, gulma, tinggi tanaman) tanpa deteksi atau pencacahan buah yang dievaluasi. Estimasi hasil disebut tanpa deteksi buah, sehingga E3 juga dapat dipertimbangkan.

judul: Green pepper fruits counting based on improved DeepSort and optimized Yolov5s
bukti_ai2: This algorithm associates identical fruits and allocates a distinct ID to each one throughout the video sequence. Ultimately, the counting of green peppers is achieved by tallying the unique IDs || The DeepSort multi-target tracking algorithm comprises four key components: the Kalman filter algorithm (Li et al., 2015), the Hungarian algorithm, the Reid model, and Cascade matching || Post-cascade matching, an additional green pepper appearance feature matching algorithm is incorporated
catatan_ai2: Acuan hitungan adalah jumlah target berlabel pada video (GT), bukan hitungan di tanaman. Kesimpulan naskah menulis ID switch turun dari 68 menjadi 28, sedangkan Tabel 6 mencatat 48 (sesuai penurunan 29,41%).

judul: Utilizing NeRF-Based Rays for Spatial Perception in Fruit Counting Deduplication
bukti_ai2: This study proposes the integration of 2D detection techniques with 3D reconstruction technologies, utilizing Rays in Neural Radiance Fields(NeRF) to overcome these challenges || combined with NVIDIA's instant-ngp for swift NeRF reconstruction, and further refined by data clustering via the DBSCAN algorithm || resulting in a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.5 oranges with a prediction accuracy of 90.625%
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak menyebut cara akuisisi (video atau foto diskret mengelilingi pohon) maupun sumber hitungan acuan; akuisisi D dan referensi pohon adalah dugaan dari konteks penghitungan per pohon.

judul: Toward Real Scenery: A Lightweight Tomato Growth Inspection Algorithm for Leaf Disease Detection and Fruit Counting
bukti_ai2: we integrated state-of-the-art trackers such as Byte-Track, Motpy, and FairMot to enable fruit counting in video streams || the combination of YOLO-TGI-S and Byte-Track achieved the best R2 of 0.93 and the lowest RMSE of 9.17 || [parafrasa web] Pencacahan memakai penyaringan ID pada batas maya (garis kuning); ID tomat dihitung saat masuk area itu; hasil dibandingkan dengan hitungan manual pada video uji.
catatan_ai2: M2 dicantumkan karena FairMOT (re-ID penampilan) termasuk pelacak yang dibandingkan; konfigurasi terbaik (Byte-Track) dan Motpy hanya memakai IoU dengan prediksi Kalman, sehingga penghapus duplikat utama adalah M3 dengan area hitung. Acuan hitung menurut halaman PMC adalah hitungan manual pada video uji, bukan hitungan di tanaman; diisi anotasi. mAP pada abstrak berlaku untuk penyakit daun, bukan buah.

judul: Kiwifruit Counting Using Kiwidetector and Kiwitracker
bukti_ai2: The KiwiTracker algorithm is from Kalman filtering and global matching for target tracking. || Hungarian algorithm is improved to match targets based on Euclidean distance and Intersection over Union (IoU) to reduce ID duplication and improve kiwifruit counting accuracy. || we manually counted the number of visible kiwifruits in 10 different videos as the ground truth (GT).
catatan_ai2: Seksi 2.1 menyebut gabungan YOLOv7 dan DeepSort, tetapi uraian pelacak hanya memuat filter Kalman dan pencocokan Hungarian berbasis jarak Euclid dan IoU tanpa fitur re-ID, sehingga dikode M3. Video diambil dari internet dan sebagian memperlihatkan konveyor sortasi; nomor halaman mengacu pada PDF versi penulis, bukan versi penerbit.

judul: AgriSORT: A Simple Online Real-time Tracking-by-Detection framework for robotics in precision agriculture
bukti_ai2: a simple, online, real-time tracking-by-detection pipeline for precision agriculture based only on motion information || At the end we compute the IoU with the current detection to perform the association and update the state of the tracklets. || it is important to not lose tracks, otherwise the same grape bunch gets counted more than once
catatan_ai2: Pelacak berbasis gerak saja: Kalman filter dengan kompensasi gerak kamera (optical flow Lucas-Kanade, transformasi afin), IoU, dan algoritme Hungarian. Tidak ada hitungan tandan yang dilaporkan atau dibandingkan dengan acuan; evaluasi hanya metrik identitas terhadap anotasi MOT. Kamera RealSense D435i dipakai, tetapi depth tidak digunakan dalam metode.

judul: System of Counting Green Oranges Directly from Trees Using Artificial Intelligence
bukti_ai2: this work aims to count green oranges directly from trees through video footage filmed in line along a row of orange trees on a plantation || The first uses the Euclidean distance between the centroids of the objects detected via YOLOv4 in subsequent frames to relate the IDs of the oranges of the previous frame || The second uses object tracking algorithms to match the IDs of the oranges of the previous frame with the oranges of the current frame that YOLOv4 has not detected.
catatan_ai2: Asosiasi berupa pencocokan centroid antarbingkai (ambang 70 piksel) ditambah pelacak objek tunggal (Dlib, KCF, CSRT, MIL, Boosting, MedianFlow) selama paling lama 35 bingkai saat detektor gagal. Pelacak korelasi memakai templat penampakan, tetapi hanya sebagai pelacakan temporal jangka pendek tanpa re-identifikasi, sehingga dikode M3 dan bukan M2+M3. Acuan hitung adalah jumlah jeruk yang terlihat di video (208) yang dihitung manual, bukan hitungan di pohon. Tiga kelas dianotasi (hijau, matang, busuk) tetapi hitungan tidak dilaporkan per kelas. Metrik identitas (MOTA, IDF1) tidak dilaporkan; hanya jumlah hitungan ganda dan ID berulang.

judul: Twice matched fruit counting system: An automatic fruit counting pipeline in modern apple orchard using mutual and secondary matches
bukti_ai2: three sub-algorithms: i) object detection model based on You Only Look Once Version 4-tiny; ii) fruit tracking with mutual match; iii) and fruit counting with ID assignment || each fruit was assigned with a unique ID based on fruit tracking results and direction of camera motion || The root mean squared error and coefficient of determination were 16.3 fruit per video and 0.93, respectively
catatan_ai2: Abstrak tidak merinci isyarat yang dipakai mutual match dan secondary match (diduga posisi/gerak antarbingkai dengan batang sebagai acuan); bila memakai deskriptor penampilan, kodenya menjadi M2+M3. Asal 'ground truth counting results' (anotasi video atau hitung di pohon) tidak dinyatakan; diisi anotasi karena satuannya buah per video.

judul: A simplified network topology for fruit detection, counting and mobile-phone deployment
bukti_ai2: recorded video of strawberry, jujube and cherry fruits saved in mp4 format were taken to investigate real-time detection speed, tracking and counting of detected fruit targets. || it was subjected to track, count and speed of detected targets fruit as displayed in Fig 4 and Table 4, and compared to YOLOv5n, YOLOv7-tiny, and YOLOv8n.
catatan_ai2: Naskah tidak menyebut nama pelacak maupun cara duplikat dihapus; M3 dikodekan menurut konvensi (pelacakan pada platform YOLOv8.0.40, sumber tidak menyatakan re-ID). Hitungan video tidak dibandingkan dengan acuan apa pun, sehingga tidak ada metrik galat hitung. Hitungan dilaporkan per jenis buah dari video terpisah, bukan per kelas kematangan atau ukuran, sehingga per_kelas N. Kontribusi utama naskah adalah arsitektur detektor; bagian pelacakan hanya demonstrasi.

judul: Remote Sensing Identification and Rapid Yield Estimation of Pitaya Plants in Different Karst Mountainous Complex Habitats

judul: Object-Detection from Multi-View remote sensing Images: A case study of fruit and flower detection and counting on a central Florida strawberry farm
bukti_ai2: Each unique strawberry object on the ground can be detected multiple times in the raw images because images have forward- and side overlap. || an improved FaceNet model was proposed to combine the image and position information to calculate the feature distance between those objects, and a clustering algorithm was used || from which the final position and number of strawberry fruits and flowers were obtained
catatan_ai2: Mekanisme: embedding FaceNet (penampilan, M2) digabung dengan informasi posisi (M4), lalu pengelompokan; karena jaraknya dipelajari, M5 juga dapat diperdebatkan. Abstrak tidak menyebut acuan hitung (hitung lapangan atau anotasi), sehingga referensi_hitung diisi anotasi sebagai dugaan. per_kelas Y disimpulkan dari akurasi per kelas atas objek unik (bunga, mentah, matang); cara penetapan kelas objek unik tidak dinyatakan. Akuisisi berupa citra UAV bertampalan (pandangan diskret).

judul: Object detection and tracking on UAV RGB videos for early extraction of grape phenotypic traits
bukti_ai2: Multi-object tracking and segmentation (MOTS) is utilized in this study to determine the traits of individual white grape bunches and berries from RGB videos obtained from a UAV || PointTrack algorithm was used for detecting and tracking the grape bunches || For tracking, the results were not sufficient when trained with 679 frames.
catatan_ai2: PointTrack mengasosiasikan instans dengan embedding terpelajar dan IoU mask, sehingga dikodekan M2+M3; abstrak tidak merinci mekanisme asosiasi. Acuan hitungan dapat mencakup pengukuran fenotipe lapangan, tetapi abstrak tidak menegaskannya.

judul: Development and evaluation of automated localisation and reconstruction of all fruits on tomato plants in a greenhouse based on multi-view perception and 3D multi-object tracking
bukti_ai2: The representation is maintained and updated from multiple viewpoints over several time steps using a 3D MOT algorithm based on a Kalman Filter and the Hungarian algorithm. || The known camera pose with respect to the robot base was then used to calculate the transformation matrix || The dataset consisted of 700 images from 100 viewpoints of seven tomato plants recorded following a semi-cylindrical path
catatan_ai2: Asosiasi dilakukan dengan jarak Mahalanobis pada posisi 3D dalam kerangka koordinat robot (pose kamera diketahui) dengan filter Kalman dan algoritme Hungarian, sehingga M3+M4. Abstrak menyebut galat 5,08%, sedangkan Tabel 3 dan kesimpulan menyebut 5,06%. Acuan berupa anotasi kotak dan ID pelacakan pada citra.

judul: Method for estimation of bagged grape yield using a self-correcting NMS-ByteTrack
bukti_ai2: [parafrasa web] Metode mendeteksi anggur berbungkus dalam video dengan YOLOv5s, memindahkan NMS ke tahap pelacakan, menambah kompensasi gerak kamera dan filter Kalman pada ByteTrack, lalu menghitung dengan strategi garis. || [parafrasa web] MOTA, MOTP, dan IDF1 masing-masing 64,6%, 82,4%, dan 80,8%; akurasi hitung rata-rata 82,8%.
catatan_ai2: Artikel terbit di jurnal berbahasa Mandarin (laman dan abstrak penerbit berbahasa Mandarin), sehingga dikeluarkan dengan E7. Bila protokol menerima artikel berbahasa Mandarin dengan abstrak Inggris, kodenya C1 (M3, pelacakan video dan garis hitung). Pembanding hitungan tidak dinyatakan dalam abstrak; 'anotasi' adalah dugaan.

judul: Citrus Identification and Counting Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5s and DeepSort
bukti_ai2: The video to be detected is fed into the trained citrus fruit detection model as video frames for target detection and followed by feeding the detected target borders and image features into the DeepSort algorithm || Calculate the Mahalanobis distance and cosine distance between the prediction frame and the detection frame to derive the cost matrix and perform the Hungarian algorithm matching. || the average multiple object tracking accuracy increased from 88.95% to 90.83%
